Page 47 Mar. 29 Friday - Mary Canning - 20 of Jamaica - having left St. Michael's Parish here while. in Hi-School moved with parents to Jamaica .... ... since going to the Jamaica High seems to have lost respect for religion, parents, duties, etc. - refuses to listen to Mother - too old-fashioned. Now absent from Home since Jan. 15th - 22 months. Enrolled To-day in Ser. Masses - Mother promising to read one book of the "Mysticle City" if things brighten inside
Apr. 3rd (five days later) Same Mary here To-day with happy Mother and waits from 11:30 to 1 o'clock to go to confession. Deo Gr. HUNTINGTON
Sep. 21st
7 month old Mary Louise Black - from 1100 Vinewood, Detroit, Mich. - cerebral hemorages - beautiful child - mystery to the doctors. Enrolled in Detroit in February (about 5th) when Dr's had no hope of her living ........ Parents enroll Poor Souls To-day- Special Membership 10.00
Page 48 Nov. 2nd Kathleen Stiverson - 13 - of 2213 Rosemont Rd. Berkley, Michigan -- sarcomic knee. Dr's call it a hopeless case; want to amputate leg.
Dec. 14
Raymond Pasko - 5 yrs. old, 18 1bs - here from Detroit, Mich. Seemingly a healthy baby for three days. Then stomach and liver went bad. Measles followed. Ailing ever since with frequent spasms. Last July fever mounted to 106 ...... Parents going to Holy Communion twice a year ... Promise to do better.
1947 Page 49
1947, April
Apr. 22nd Rev. Cha's J. Lehwald of Jefferson, Wis. - Enrolled - as for sight improvement .... Promises to procure if he can and read the "Mysti- cal City of God" - 4 volumns if - if cured.
Apr. 28 Francis Noris came from Detroit: had been studying medicine for several years - two yrs. more to graduate when recently on coming to passage: "Seek ye first the kingdom of God and His justice" - he decided to show a little gratitude by consecrating himself to God. Seems docile and willing to follow suggestion to be Cap- uchin priest - 27 yrs. of age.
